content_sections.heading: DIBD Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DIBD Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DIBD Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DIBD Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Ecosystem Engagement Manager - Hyderabad and 1 for Ecosystem Engagement Manager - NER.

content_sections.heading: DIBD Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Ecosystem Engagement Manager - Hyderabad & Ecosystem Engagement Manager - NER: Full time B.S./ B.Tech./ B.E. or equivalent degree or B.Sc. (IT/ CS) with Post-Graduation in Technical Background; MBA/ MTech preferable; 5+ years experience in consulting/ strategy/ project management/ technology consulting.

content_sections.heading: DIBD Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 58 years for all posts. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DIBD Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DIBD to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIBD Ecosystem Engagement Manager posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the DIBD Ecosystem Engagement Manager positions is 08 September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Ecosystem Engagement Manager post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Ecosystem Engagement Manager post. These positions are located in Hyderabad and the North-Eastern Region (NER).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time B.S./B.Tech./B.E. or equivalent degree, or a B.Sc. (IT/CS) with Post-Graduation in a technical background. An MBA/MTech is preferable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the DIBD recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Ecosystem Engagement Manager role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in this recruitment is 58 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for the candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the experience required for the Ecosystem Engagement Manager position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have at least 5 years of relevant experience in areas such as consulting, strategy, project management, or technology consulting.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DIBD Ecosystem Engagement Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve two main stages: an initial screening of applications followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Ecosystem Engagement Manager posts?
faq.answer: The positions of Ecosystem Engagement Manager are offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.answer: The official website of the Digital India Bhashini Division is https://bhashini.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and updates.
